```{ojs}
// Parameters
n = 30
sigma = 10
mu0 = 200

// Slider for observed sample mean
viewof xbar_obs = Inputs.range([mu0 - 3*sigma, mu0 + 3*sigma], 
  {step: 0.5, value: mu0, label: md`Observed sample mean ${tex`\bar{x}_{obs}`}`} )

// Likelihood under H0 (point null)
m0 = 1/(sigma/Math.sqrt(n)*Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI)) *
     Math.exp(-0.5*((xbar_obs - mu0)/(sigma/Math.sqrt(n)))**2)

// Marginal likelihood under H1 (normal prior on mu)
tau = 25        // prior variance for H1
post_var = 1 / (1/tau + n/sigma**2)
post_mean = post_var * (mu0/tau + n*xbar_obs/sigma**2)

// Under H1, the marginal distribution of xbar is Normal(mu0, sigma^2/n + tau)
m1 = 1/Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI*(sigma**2/n + tau)) *
     Math.exp(-0.5*((xbar_obs - mu0)**2)/(sigma**2/n + tau))

// Bayes factor
B10 = m1/m0

md`**Bayes factor** ${tex`B_{10}`} = ${B10.toFixed(3)}`
```
